issues.where: stem and petioles of the main plant, full height
issues.what: the water drops are evenly spaced, same-size white dots running in a neat line down the stem, like painted spots or a bead texture. They have no refraction or highlight variation, no running or merging, and on the lower stem they swell into pale flat blobs. They read as decals even at normal playback speed
issues.fix: scatter drops with random size and spacing, give them proper refraction and specular highlights, add runs and merged drops, and thin them out on the shaded side

issues.where: crop 2 and crop 6, the small dark leaf at the stem base (left of stem)
issues.what: the leaf is covered in a uniform white polka-dot speckle. The dots are evenly spread and do not follow the leaf's tilt or curvature, so the leaf reads as a flat card with a dotted texture rather than a wet leaf
issues.fix: use real modelled drops that bead up and pool along the veins and the low edge, with sizes that vary and fall off toward the edges

issues.where: crops 1, 3 and 5, the upper leaves against the bright sky
issues.what: the leaves are lit from behind by a bright sky but show no light coming through. They are near-black, opaque, flat dark green, with no glow at the edges or through the vein network. The top leaves look like stiff cut-out cards with crisp knife edges
issues.fix: add subsurface or translucency so thin leaf tissue glows yellow-green against the sky, show the veins against the light, and soften and thicken the edges with a slight curl

issues.where: crop 4 (labelled leaf with the light behind it)
issues.what: no leaf in this crop is actually backlit. The leaves are front-lit or flat-lit against dark soil, so the backlit-leaf check cannot pass
issues.fix: either frame a leaf against the bright horizon or reposition the key light so a leaf is actually backlit, with visible translucency

issues.what: no hairs are visible anywhere on the stem or petioles, even where the stem is silhouetted against the bright puddle and the sky. The stem is a smooth, waxy tube, pale tan near the base, with a hard boundary between the green and tan sections
issues.fix: add fine trichomes that catch the rim light in silhouette, and blend the stem colour gradually from green down to the base

issues.where: crop 6, where the stem meets the soil
issues.what: the stem base looks planted on top of the soil, with no soil pushed up around it, no darkened wet ring and no real contact shadow. The bright tan base makes it look pasted in
issues.fix: sink the stem into a slight mound of soil, add a contact shadow and ambient occlusion, and darken the soil where it touches the stem

issues.where: crop 6, white object left of the stem base by the puddle
issues.what: a stray white object like a split shell, a petal or a crocus bud sits on the soil. It has no clear purpose, is the brightest thing in the lower frame and reads as a misplaced asset
issues.fix: remove it, or if it is meant to be a seed husk, make it the right size, dirty it and partly bury it

issues.what: the rain is a single overlay layer. The streaks are all the same brightness, length and angle whether they fall in front of the near soil or the far sky, they show no depth-of-field blur at near or far distances, and they do not get lighter or denser with distance. The rain sits on top of the picture, not inside it
issues.fix: render rain in depth with varied streak length and blur by distance, add atmospheric haze between rows, and tie the splashes on the puddle and leaves to the drops

issues.what: the background seedlings are visibly the same model repeated, with the same leaf silhouette and posture copied across the rows
issues.fix: vary scale, rotation, leaf count and growth stage for each instance, and add some gaps and damaged plants

issues.what: the white specular speckle on the soil is very even and looks a little like repeating noise. The soil clods are close in size, with few real stones, roots or straw
issues.fix: break up the soil with larger clods, small stones, organic debris and varied wetness, and lower the uniform glitter

issues.what: the veins look like they are in a normal or bump map only. The leaf blade does not dip or bulge between veins, and the leaf has one flat dark green with little colour change from the midrib to the edge
issues.fix: add real leaf displacement between veins and vary the hue and saturation across each leaf

issues.what: the three crops are almost the same framing of the plant top, so the pack shows no separate close-ups of the bud, a front-facing leaf or the water drops
issues.fix: take separate crops for the apical bud, a single leaf face-on and a close-up of the drops
